column.name: report_sql
column.value: select msa.currency_code as "Currency", case when msa.deposit_type_enum = 200 then 'Fixed Deposit' else 'Recurring Deposit' end as "Category", mc.account_no as "CustomerID", case when mdatap.deposit_period_frequency_enum = 0 then concat(mdatap.deposit_period, ' Days') when mdatap.deposit_period_frequency_enum = 1 then concat(mdatap.deposit_period, ' Weeks') when mdatap.deposit_period_frequency_enum = 2 then concat(mdatap.deposit_period, ' Months') when mdatap.deposit_period_frequency_enum = 3 then concat(mdatap.deposit_period, ' Years') else concat(mdatap.deposit_period, '') end as "Tenure", '' as "Next Interest Due", '' as "NextInterestDueDate", mc.display_name as "Customer Name", msa.account_no as "ContractID", TO_CHAR(msa.submittedon_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Opening Date", mdatap.deposit_amount as "Amount", mdatap.maturity_amount as "Balance", msa.nominal_annual_interest_rate as "Interest Rate", msa.total_interest_earned_derived as "Interest Payable", msa.nominal_annual_interest_rate/365 as "Daily Interest Rate", TO_CHAR(mdatap.maturity_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Maturity Date", ms.display_name as "Account Officer" from m_savings_account msa join m_client mc on msa.client_id = mc.id join m_deposit_account_term_and_preclosure mdatap on msa.id = mdatap.savings_account_id left join m_staff ms on msa.field_officer_id = ms.id where (msa.submittedon_date >= '${startDate}' or '${startDate}' is null) and (msa.submittedon_date <= '${endDate}' or '${endDate}' is null)

column.name: report_id
column.valueComputed: (SELECT id FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Deposit Listing')
